runtimeColor.note: Not tokens. Computed per book in js/script.js from its Open Library cover; never author these values.
runtimeColor.spineGround: Most frequent border colour of the cover (canvas 40x60, 3-bit-per-channel buckets). CSS var --g.
runtimeColor.spineLettering: Most frequent cover colour with >= 4.5:1 contrast against the ground; else near-white (250,250,250) or near-black (20,20,20), whichever contrasts more. CSS var --l.
runtimeColor.coverTint: Saturation-weighted average cover colour; cover background fallback and detail-hero tint. CSS var --c.
runtimeColor.spineEmblem: Square art-window crop outside the top/bottom title bands, rejected where hard-edge density > 0.3; omitted below score 0.42. CSS vars --emblem, --ex, --ey, --es.
runtimeColor.coverlessVolumes: Borrow ground, lettering and emblem from the series' first covered volume; with no donor, a ground hashed from eight fixed deep fallback colours, lettering by lightness.
runtimeColor.coverChoice: Per edition: English/German preferred (German when the title looks German), exact title match scores higher; product photos (white corners, no continuous white border) skipped for flat covers.

display.purpose: Shelf owner's name in the page header; one per page.

headline.purpose: Book title in the detail drawer; modal titles at 24px.

numeral.purpose: Header stats with tabular figures; 22px on phones.

body.purpose: Running text; blurbs at 1.55 line-height, max 62ch.

label.purpose: Row and field labels, filter pills, segmented options; 12px for stat labels and tags.

spine.purpose: Vertical spine titles; auto-shrunk in 0.5px steps down to 9px to fit.

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: Detail drawer over scrim; at >=1024px: -1px 0 0 var(--line), -30px 0 60px -40px rgba(20,20,20,0.35).

shadows.name: tile
shadows.purpose: Cover tile at rest; 0 20px 26px -12px rgba(20,20,20,0.55) on hover.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Shared curve for every entrance and the book turn (--ease-out).

motion.name: book-turn
motion.purpose: Signature 3D spine-to-cover turn: rotateY(-90deg) about the spine.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover, border and colour changes on controls.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation and transition collapses under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Owner's primary action, e.g. + Buch and modal confirms.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: -0.005em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--red, #d23a24); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--red, #d23a24); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.2) inset, 0 4px 10px -4px rgba(20,20,20,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--red-hover, #bb2f1b); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Cancel and secondary actions in modals and panels.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #dcdad5); color: var(--ink, #141414); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #c4c1bb; background: var(--surface-2, #f6f5f2); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--red, #d23a24); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button (destructive)
components.description: Quiet text action; the destructive variant turns soft red on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #3a3936); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(20,20,20,0.05); color: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-btn-ghost.ds-danger:hover { background: rgba(210,58,36,0.1); color: var(--red-hover, #bb2f1b); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--red, #d23a24); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Pills
components.description: Category filter row; active state is ink, never red.
components.css: .ds-pills { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-pill { height: 32px; padding: 0 13px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dcdad5); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink-2, #3a3936); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-pill:hover { border-color: #c4c1bb; color: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-pill.ds-active { background: var(--ink, #141414); border-color: var(--ink, #141414); color: #fff; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--red, #d23a24); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Regal / Cover Toggle
components.description: Segmented switch between shelf view and cover grid.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--wall-2, #e6e4df); border: 1px solid var(--line, #dcdad5); } .ds-seg button { height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; border: none; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: var(--dim, #5e5c58); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #141414); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,20,0.12); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--red, #d23a24); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Shelf and people search; fields share the red focus border and ring.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M20 20l-3.5-3.5"/></svg><input type="text" placeholder="Reihe oder Titel suchen"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 260px; } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; left: 13px; width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--dim, #5e5c58); pointer-events: none; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px 0 38px; background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #dcdad5); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--ink, #141414); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--dim, #5e5c58); } .ds-search input:hover { border-color: #c4c1bb; } .ds-search input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--red, #d23a24); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(210,58,36,0.28); }

components.name: Book on Ledge
components.description: Signature: spines with runtime-derived colours on a steel ledge; one volume face-out per series. Demo values stand in for colours computed from covers.
components.html: Red Rising1Golden Son2Morning StarPierce Brown · Band 3Iron Gold4
components.css: .ds-ledge { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 2px; padding: 22px 18px 0; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ledge::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -15px; height: 15px; border-radius: 1.5px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #555 0, #2a2a2a 2px, #1d1d1d 40%, #0e0e0e 100%); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -2px rgba(20,20,20,0.3), 0 22px 26px -14px rgba(20,20,20,0.45); } .ds-spine { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 0 9px; border-radius: 2px 2px 1px 1px; background: rgb(var(--g)); color: rgb(var(--l)); box-shadow: inset -1px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.3), inset 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.16), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.2); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-spine:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); } .ds-spine b { flex: 1; writing-mode: vertical-rl; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.08; } .ds-spine i { font-style: normal; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-cover { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; padding: 14px 12px 12px 16px; border-radius: 1px 4px 4px 1px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.12), transparent 50%), linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.35), transparent 60%), rgb(var(--c)); color: #fafafa; box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.16), inset 8px 0 8px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.35), 18px 22px 30px -14px rgba(20,20,20,0.55); } .ds-cover b { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-cover small { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Cover Tile
components.description: Cover view item: 2:3 cover, title, volume, red stars; selected tile gets a red outline.
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 132px; padding: 0; border: none; background: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-tile-cover { aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; margin-bottom: 8px; border-radius: 3px 6px 6px 3px; background: rgb(var(--c)); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.16), inset 7px 0 7px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 12px 20px -12px rgba(20,20,20,0.5); transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-cover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.16), inset 7px 0 7px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 20px 26px -12px rgba(20,20,20,0.55); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--red, #d23a24); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tile:active .ds-tile-cover { outline: 3px solid var(--red, #d23a24); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tile-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-tile-meta { font-size: 13px; color: var(--dim, #5e5c58); } .ds-tile-stars { display: flex; gap: 1px; } .ds-tile-stars svg { width: 11px; height: 11px; }

components.name: Toast
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-block; padding: 11px 18px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--ink, #141414); color: #fff; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -16px rgba(20,20,20,0.28), 0 2px 6px rgba(20,20,20,0.06); }

narrative.overview:
A contemporary design-bookshop wall, not a library and not a tracker. A pale, warm-grey gallery ground carries full-width black steel ledges; real books stand spine-out on them, every spine dressed in colours and a small art crop lifted from that book's own cover, and one click turns a volume face-out in 3D. The chrome is quiet, neutral and set entirely in Geist; the covers are the only rich colour on the page, so the collection itself is the interface.

Density is calm but not sparse: series sit side by side on their own ledges (wrapping on wide screens, one per row on phones), headed by a bold series title with author and volume count. Book detail lives in a white panel with a soft long shadow, beside the shelf on large screens and as a bottom sheet on phones. One signal red marks the primary action, the current selection and filled stars, and nothing else.

The world rejects both the flat list tracker and the wood-and-brass library rendering of the shelf metaphor.
keyCharacteristics: Gallery-wall neutral ground, ink text, matte black steel ledges.
Covers carry all saturated colour; spines are computed from covers at runtime.
One signal red, reserved for primary action, selection and stars.
Geist everywhere, heavy weights with tight negative tracking on display sizes, tabular numerals for counts.
One signature motion: the CSS 3D spine-to-cover turn.
White cards and drawers lifted by soft, long, ink-tinted shadows.

rules.name: The Covers-Carry-Colour Rule
rules.body: Chrome stays in the wall, ink, line and steel neutrals plus one red. Every other saturated colour on screen comes from a book cover or is computed from one.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Signal red marks the primary action, the current selection, focus and filled stars. Active filters use ink, not red; red never fills a large area or decorates.

rules.name: The Derived Spine Rule
rules.body: Spine ground, lettering and emblem are computed from the cover at runtime. A spine colour is never hand-picked.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: The larger the type, the heavier and tighter it sets: display at -0.04em, headlines at -0.035em, titles at -0.025em; body text is never negatively tracked.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Every count, rating and volume number uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Soft Long Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are long, soft, negatively spread and ink-tinted. No hard offset shadows, no coloured glows.

rules.name: The One Turn Rule
rules.body: The 3D spine-to-cover turn is the only signature motion. Everything else is a short ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)) entrance or a 0.15s state change, and all motion collapses under reduced-motion.

rules.name: The One Face-Out Rule
rules.body: Each series shows exactly one cover; every other volume stays spine-out.

dos: **Do** derive every spine's ground, lettering and emblem from its cover at runtime, and let coverless volumes borrow from the series' first covered volume.
**Do** keep chrome in the neutral tokens and reserve signal red for the primary action, selection, focus and stars.
**Do** stand books on black steel ledges with soft contact and ledge shadows.
**Do** set display sizes in Geist 800 with negative tracking, and counts in tabular numerals.
**Do** lift white cards, drawers and popovers with the soft long shadows listed above.
**Do** keep detail beside the shelf without a scrim at ≥1024px, and as a bottom sheet with a scrim on phones.
donts: **Don't** hand-pick spine colours or introduce chrome colours that compete with covers.
**Don't** use red for active filters, decoration or large fills; active filters are ink.
**Don't** render the shelf as wood and brass, or flatten it into a list tracker.
**Don't** add a second signature motion beside the spine-to-cover turn.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows or coloured glows.
**Don't** show more than one face-out cover per series.
